tour.overview:
Off the north-east coast of Zanzibar, Mnemba Atoll is surrounded by a marine conservation area of coral reefs and clear water, home to green turtles, reef fish and dolphins. The island itself is private, but the reefs around it are among the best snorkelling sites in East Africa. Sandbanks appear at low tide in the turquoise lagoons.

This private boat day takes you there with a local guide, at your own pace.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 7 hours
• Start and end: your hotel on Zanzibar
• Type: private boat with crew and local guide; vehicle transfers
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy

WHAT YOU SEE
• Dolphins.
• The Mnemba reefs.
• A sandbank.

WHY THIS WORKS
A private boat lets you choose when to watch dolphins quietly and snorkel away from crowded spots.

WHO IT SUITS
Families, couples and snorkellers.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For culture, choose our Stone Town and spice tour.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
We follow responsible dolphin-watching rules: no chasing and no forced swimming with them. Use reef-safe sun cream.

days.name: Dolphins, the Mnemba reefs and a sandbank lunch
days.description:
What to expect: a day on the Indian Ocean, with a private boat, guide, equipment and lunch.

Your driver collects you and takes you to Matemwe or Nungwi, where you board your private boat. As you head out, your guide watches for dolphins, often spinner and bottlenose dolphins, which you observe quietly from the boat.

At the Mnemba reefs, you snorkel over coral gardens in clear water, among parrotfish, angelfish, clownfish and starfish, and often green turtles grazing on the sea grass. After a second snorkelling stop, you land on a white sandbank for a lunch of grilled fish, octopus and fresh fruit, with time to swim and relax before the boat brings you back.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:00 – Pick-up.
09:00 – Boat departure.
09:30 – Dolphin watching.
10:30 – Snorkelling at Mnemba.
12:30 – Sandbank lunch.
14:30 – Return.
15:30 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Tides affect the sandbank; your guide plans the day around them.

INCLUDED: transfers, private boat and crew, guide, conservation fee, equipment, lunch, drinks.
NOT INCLUDED: tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: lunch.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Can we swim with dolphins?
faq.answer: We watch them responsibly from the boat; entering the water near them is discouraged.

faq.question: Do we need to be good swimmers?
faq.answer: Basic swimming ability is enough; life vests are provided.

faq.question: Is lunch included?
faq.answer: Yes, a seafood lunch; vegetarian options are available.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Child life vests are provided.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Partly; boarding from the beach requires wading.

faq.question: Will we see turtles?
faq.answer: Often; they are wild, so sightings are never guaranteed.

faq.question: Can we land on Mnemba Island?
What should we bring?
faq.answer: Swimwear, a towel, a hat and reef-safe sun cream.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: June to October and December to March.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary on safari in Tanzania: guides, drivers and camp staff appreciate a tip if you were happy with their service, but it is always your choice. Your guide can suggest typical amounts.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
